# CLI reference

<!-- Auto-generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from cancellai's argparse definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

## `cancellai`

```text
usage: cancellai [-h] [--version] {clean,status,configure,version} ...

Safely reclaim disk space from old Codex and Claude Code sessions.

positional arguments:
  {clean,status,configure,version}
    clean               Clean old session data (default when other args are given without a
                        subcommand)
    status              Show disk usage and cleanup candidates (default command)
    configure           Configure Claude Code's built-in retention
    version             Print version

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `cancellai clean`

```text
usage: cancellai clean [-h] [--days DAYS] [--keep-latest KEEP_LATEST] [--tool {all,codex,claude}]
                       [--codex-backend {auto,cli,filesystem}] [--aggressive] [--json] [--dry-run]
                       [-y] [--allow-running] [--keep-claude-history] [--verbose]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --days DAYS           Delete data older than N days (default: 7)
  --keep-latest KEEP_LATEST
                        Always keep at least N newest sessions per tool (default: 2)
  --tool {all,codex,claude}
  --codex-backend {auto,cli,filesystem}
                        auto/cli prefer official 'codex delete --force'; filesystem is an explicit
                        unsafe-compatibility fallback
  --aggressive          Also remove Claude legacy/rebuildable caches
  --json                Machine-readable summary
  --dry-run             Preview only; delete nothing
  -y, --yes             Skip confirmation
  --allow-running       Allow cleanup even if Codex/Claude processes appear active
  --keep-claude-history
                        Do not trim prompt-history lines tied to deleted Claude sessions
  --verbose
```

## `cancellai status`

```text
usage: cancellai status [-h] [--days DAYS] [--keep-latest KEEP_LATEST] [--tool {all,codex,claude}]
                        [--codex-backend {auto,cli,filesystem}] [--aggressive] [--json] [--paths]
                        [--coverage] [--top TOP]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --days DAYS           Delete data older than N days (default: 7)
  --keep-latest KEEP_LATEST
                        Always keep at least N newest sessions per tool (default: 2)
  --tool {all,codex,claude}
  --codex-backend {auto,cli,filesystem}
                        auto/cli prefer official 'codex delete --force'; filesystem is an explicit
                        unsafe-compatibility fallback
  --aggressive          Also remove Claude legacy/rebuildable caches
  --json                Machine-readable summary
  --paths               Show largest candidate paths
  --coverage            Report which top-level provider entries this build classifies, including
                        unknown ones
  --top TOP             Number of top-level disk consumers to show
```
